summary: Tested the Stripe test/live mode separation, the manual Revenue Leaks invoice step, the UpdatePrompt, chunk-error auto-reload and the Featurebase changelog. Backend: 16 of 16 pytest pass. The new file test_stripe_mode_separation.py covers: checkout on pro_monthly and essential_yearly returns a client_secret; the cached price is reused (no duplicate); the legacy coupon doc with no mode is reused as test mode; subscription/details works; a simulated live mode (sk_live_fake + stubbed Product/Price/Coupon.create) creates new docs tagged 'live' and does not overwrite the test doc; _same_mode is correct in both modes; a legacy subscription ID with no stripe_livemode is still sent to Stripe, while a live-tagged ID is ignored by details, auto-renew and the billing portal. The old live_draft/stripe_live assertions in test_telemetry_leaks.py were updated to the new 'manual' behaviour. Frontend: the draft note, approve result text and the Open Stripe link (href and target _blank) are correct. With Playwright routing, the update prompt appears on focus, dismiss hides it and later focus events don't bring it back, Refresh reloads the page, and with no routing no prompt appears. Chunk recovery: a single aborted Settings chunk causes one auto reload and Settings then renders; a chunk that always fails reloads once and then shows the fallback with a Reload button (no loop). Dashboard, /sync, /settings and the Feedback tab all load. All Featurebase identify/changelog/feedback/messenger requests return 200.

minor.issue: The leak is set to 'recovering' before the CRM insert and email send. If db.deals.insert_one raises, the leak stays in 'recovering' forever (nothing rolls it back) and can't be approved or dismissed again. This existed before this change but is still present.

ui_bugs.issue: After approve, the success toast still says 'Recovery executed — invoice drafted, CRM opportunity created'. InFlow no longer drafts an invoice, so the message is misleading (pages/RevenueLeaks.js L153). Suggested text: 'Recovery executed — CRM opportunity created; create the invoice in your Stripe'.

issues: The pill is at bottom-6 with z-[9999]. While the Termly cookie banner is showing (anyone who hasn't consented yet), the banner sits on top of the pill, hiding it and catching clicks on Refresh/Dismiss (Playwright: 'termly-code-snippet-support intercepts pointer events'). Raise the pill's z-index above Termly or move it up while the banner is visible.

action_items: Change the Revenue Leaks approve toast text so it no longer says 'invoice drafted' (RevenueLeaks.js L153)
Make sure the UpdatePrompt pill shows and is clickable above the Termly cookie banner
Optional: in approve_recovery, wrap the post-claim steps in try/except and put the leak back to 'open' on failure
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py mode handling is consistent: price and coupon lookups are filtered by mode ({'$ne':'live'} for test, so legacy docs count as test), the in-memory price cache key includes the mode, and the upsert filter includes the mode, so test docs aren't overwritten in live mode.

_resolve_stripe_customer_id: if the user doc is tagged live, it falls back to the latest paid transaction, and a legacy transaction with no stripe_livemode counts as test. That's correct for this change, but a user's test-mode history can still provide a customer ID while in test mode. Fine for the beta.
Webhook customer.subscription.* handlers (if any update IDs) should also stamp stripe_livemode from event.livemode. Only checkout.session.completed was confirmed to set it.

Seen in the console: '[Featurebase SDK] Error with action: identify. The Data you provided has validation errors' (x2). This is a client-side SDK validation warning. Every identify call to the server returns 200 and the widgets load. It doesn't appear to come from the changelog hook, but the Provider's identify payload is worth checking. React hydration warnings on Dashboard (<th>/<tr> inside a span) come from the visual-edit wrapper, not from app code.
seed_data_creation: Ran seed_telemetry.py and then a scan. The Acme leak was approved through the UI and is now 'recovered' with actions.invoice.mode='manual'. Test-mode checkout sessions were created (not paid), which leaves pending payment_transactions. No live-mode docs were left (stripe_prices/stripe_coupons with mode 'live': 0). testpro is still enterprise_monthly, and the temporary stripe_subscription_id/stripe_livemode fields were removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_telemetry_leaks.py TestScan needs the Acme contract to exist. Run seed_telemetry.py first if contracts_scanned==0. The UpdatePrompt check needs Playwright routing that injects main.v1.js into the document HTML and serves main.v2.js for '/?_v=*'. Accept the Termly banner first or the clicks are blocked. For the chunk test, abort requests containing 'src_pages_Settings_js.chunk.js' and navigate with pushState + popstate.
